glosses: soziale Kontakte meist durch digitale Kommunikation knüpfen und pflegen

translations.source_sense_description: soziale Kontakte meist durch digitale Kommunikation knüpfen und pflegen

examples.text: A network of roads crisscrossed the country.
The many species that live in the forest canopy constitute a network of life via their complex interactions.

glosses: A set of people with sociocultural connections to one another; especially, such a set consisting of occupational or business connections.

examples.text: To get a job in today's economy, it is important to have a strong network.
For people with mental health challenges, having a support network of family and friends can improve the chances of maintaining successful mental health care.

glosses: A group of affiliated television stations that broadcast common programs from a parent company.

examples.text:
2008, Lou Schuler, "Foreward", in Nate Green, Built for Show, page xi
TV back then was five channels (three networks, PBS, and an independent station that ran I Love Lucy reruns), […]

glosses: A computer network: multiple computers and other devices connected together to share information.

examples.text: The copy machine is connected to the network so it can now serve as a printer.

glosses: A fabric or structure of fibrous elements attached to each other at regular intervals; the act or process of making such an object.

examples.text: He wore a mantle of network.

glosses: To interact socially for the purpose of getting connections or personal advancement.

examples.text: Many people find it worthwhile to network for jobs and information.

glosses: To connect two or more computers or other computerized devices.

examples.text: If we network his machine to the server, he will be able to see all the files.

glosses: To interconnect a group or system.
To broadcast across an entire network of stations and affiliates at the same time.
